issues.title: Read-only .troupe/ crashes history store with traceback (exit 1)
issues.description: If <theatre>/.troupe/ is not writable, opening the SQLite history raises and exits 1 with a traceback instead of a contracted exit code naming the file (TROUPE-003). Map to a TroupeError (likely exit 4) naming .troupe/history.sqlite. Found in WP08 review.

issues.title: Add .gitignore for Python build artefacts
issues.description: The repo has no .gitignore entries for __pycache__/, .venv/, .pytest_cache/, .mypy_cache/, .ruff_cache/ (troupe mission troupe-config-load-show-set). Untracked caches block spec-kitty move-task. Add entries on feat/troupe-config-load-show-set after lane merge, before merging to main.

issues.title: show: plain scalars valid in YAML 1.2 core misread by ruamel safe-load (dates, <<, signed hex, 1_000)
issues.description: Found in WP01 review (troupe-config-get-show-01M411XB). yamlout reuses writeback.scalars.choose_style, whose can_plain uses troupe's own YAML 1.2 core resolver (research R-13). Strings like '2001-12-14', '-0x10', '+0x10', '0x1_0', '-0o7', '0b101', '1_000', '-1_0', '=' and the key '<<' render plain. Under YAML 1.2 core they read back as the same strings, but ruamel safe-load (the oracle named in research D-8 / plan Testing) reads dates as datetime.date, signed/underscored numbers as int, '=' raises ConstructorError, and '<<' is treated as a merge key (k '<<: {a: 1}' reads back as {a: 1}; '<<: 29' raises). Decide: (a) amend NFR-001/D-8 to state YAML 1.2 core is the read-back schema and keep fixtures free of these, or (b) make show (and possibly set) quote strings that ruamel/YAML 1.1-style resolvers would re-type. WP03 integration fixtures (e.g. tests/integration/test_show.py uses b: 2001-12-14, c: 1_000) will hit this if parsed back with ruamel safe-load.
issues.close_reason: Fixed by D-10 in WP01 cycle 2 (yamlout quotes strings YAML 1.1/1.2 readers misread; exponent floats keep a '.'); merged to main in a589041

issues.title: Add integration test for set write failure (OSError -> exit 3, no events)
issues.description: set_value.py maps OSError during atomic write to WriteRefused (exit 3) naming the file and records no history; verified manually in WP08 review but no automated test covers it.

issues.title: Shared YAML include edited via one path is refused without explanation
issues.description: set x.v 2 exits 3 when x and y both include a/x.yaml (R-17 'other leaves unchanged'). Conservative, but the message 'cannot write this change byte-surgically' does not say the include is shared. Improve message or ask product owner whether both paths may change. Found in WP08 review.

issues.title: Folded block with only whitespace lines: no-op detection / needless refusal
issues.description:
blocks.parse_block falls back to parent_indent+indent_step when a folded block has no text line, so whitespace-only lines count as more-indented: a: >
     
 set to 'x
y
' is refused (exit 3, safe but unnecessary) and set to '   
' returns no edits though value differs. Found in WP06 re-review; WP08 verify-before-write mitigates.

issues.title: Map PermissionError during include resolution to LoadError
issues.description: src/troupe/loader.py _include: Path.exists()/is_dir() raise PermissionError for an include under an unreadable directory, producing a traceback instead of exit 4 naming the file (found in WP02 review, mission troupe-config-load-show-set).

issues.title: yamlcore docstring says no other module imports ruamel; yamlout now does (D-10 probe)
issues.description: WP01 cycle 2 (troupe-config-get-show) added a ruamel safe-load read-back probe in src/troupe/yamlout.py (documented exception there). src/troupe/yamlcore.py module docstring still states 'No other module imports ruamel'. Either move the probe into yamlcore (e.g. yamlcore.safe_load_as(text, version)) or update the yamlcore docstring, so the library boundary is stated in one place (TROUPE-007).

issues.title: show: mapping keys >1024 chars do not read back
issues.description: troupe config show renders keys as implicit keys ('k': v). YAML forbids implicit keys longer than 1024 chars, so a theatre with such a key (loader accepts explicit '? key' syntax) yields show output that does not parse back (NFR-001 gap). Found by WP01 implementer, mission troupe-config-get-show-01M411XB. Contract silent; fix would need explicit-key layout ('? key' / ': value') — PO decision.
